meta.note: COMMUNITY-OBSERVED, NOT AN OFFICIAL FIVERR LIST. Fiverr does not publish its filter; these rules come from field observation and common policy themes. Passing this linter does not guarantee Fiverr will accept the text, and failing it does not mean Fiverr will block it.
meta.safe_sentence: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Email address
rules.rationale: Sharing an email address is the most common trigger for the 'keep conversations on Fiverr' block.
rules.suggestion: Remove the address and invite the buyer to continue in the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: Email me at john.doe@gmail.com for the details
examples.good: Send your brief through the Fiverr inbox and I will reply within a day

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Obfuscated email (at/dot)
rules.rationale: Writing an address as 'name (at) site (dot) com' is still an email address and is the classic evasion attempt.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; do not try to disguise contact details.

examples.bad: reach me: john (at) gmail (dot) com
examples.good: We will meet at the studio in the evening

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Mail provider name (incl. spaced-out)
rules.rationale: Naming a mail provider, even spaced out as 'g m a i l', signals off-platform contact intent.
rules.suggestion: Remove it and keep the conversation in the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: Add me on g.m.a.i.l and we continue
examples.good: Add the details to your order requirements

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Phone number
rules.rationale: Phone numbers (9 to 15 digits, any common formatting) are blocked as off-platform contact details.
rules.suggestion: Remove the number.

examples.bad: Text me +92 300 1234567 anytime
examples.good: I delivered 250 orders in 2026-10 with 5 revisions

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Phone number spelled out in words
rules.rationale: Digits written as words ('zero three zero zero ...') are a known evasion for phone numbers.
rules.suggestion: Remove the number.

examples.bad: call zero three zero zero one two three four five
examples.good: I offer two revisions and one round of feedback

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: WhatsApp
rules.rationale: WhatsApp is the single most-blocked destination for moving a buyer off the platform.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; offer to continue in the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: Message me on W h a t s A p p
examples.good: I answer every message in the Fiverr inbox

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Telegram
rules.rationale: Telegram is treated as an off-platform chat channel.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; use the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: find me on telegram
examples.good: Questions are welcome in the order chat

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Skype
rules.rationale: Skype is treated as an off-platform chat/call channel.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; use the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: add me on skype
examples.good: We can discuss it in the order chat

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Discord
rules.rationale: Confirmed live to trigger the filter in a normal discovery message.
rules.suggestion: Say 'community group' only if truly needed; otherwise remove.

examples.bad: join my discord
examples.good: Join the order conversation any time

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Other chat apps (Viber, WeChat, KakaoTalk, LINE)
rules.rationale: Other messaging apps are treated like WhatsApp.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; use the Fiverr inbox.

examples.bad: my wechat is open
examples.good: My inbox is open every day

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: External meeting tool
rules.rationale: Zoom, Google Meet and similar tools imply moving the conversation off Fiverr. (Can be a false positive in video gigs that mean camera zoom.)
rules.suggestion: Use Fiverr's own scheduling/offer features or the inbox.

examples.bad: we can meet on Zoom tomorrow
examples.good: We can plan the project in the order chat

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Call me / let's have a call
rules.rationale: Suggesting a call is read as moving off-platform.
rules.suggestion: Offer to answer in the inbox instead.

examples.bad: Let's have a quick call tomorrow
examples.good: Send me your questions and I will answer here

rules.rewrite: message me here

rules.name: DM me / contact outside Fiverr
rules.rationale: Phrases that explicitly invite off-platform contact are blocked and can lead to account warnings.
rules.suggestion: Keep every step inside Fiverr.

examples.bad: DM me and we continue outside of Fiverr
examples.good: Message me here and we will finish the order together

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: 'Contact me'
rules.rationale: Field-observed as risky in seller-to-buyer messages (see rule catalogue note).
rules.suggestion: Say 'message me here' instead.

examples.bad: Please contact me when you are ready
examples.good: Please message me here when you are ready

rules.rewrite: message me here

rules.name: External URL
rules.rationale: External links in gigs and messages are blocked or stripped. Fiverr's own links are allowed.
rules.suggestion: Put work samples in the gig gallery/portfolio instead of linking out.

examples.bad: See my work at https://example-portfolio.com/work
examples.good: See the samples in my gig gallery

rules.rewrite: (link shared in the Fiverr inbox)

rules.name: @handle
rules.rationale: '@' handles read as social or chat usernames.
rules.suggestion: Remove the handle.

examples.bad: I am @johndesigns everywhere
examples.good: I am a designer based in Bali

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: Social profile pointer
rules.rationale: Pointing buyers to your social profiles is off-platform contact.
rules.suggestion: Remove it.

examples.bad: Follow me on instagram for more
examples.good: Browse the gig gallery for more

rules.rewrite: Let's keep everything in Fiverr's inbox so you're protected

rules.name: 'my website / my site'
rules.rationale: Field-observed as a trigger; it points the buyer to an off-platform site.
rules.suggestion: Point to your gig portfolio instead.

examples.bad: Please check my website first
examples.good: Please check my gig portfolio first

rules.rewrite: my gig portfolio

rules.name: Outside payment service
rules.rationale: Naming an outside payment service is blocked: all payments must go through Fiverr.
rules.suggestion: Remove it; the buyer pays through Fiverr checkout.

examples.bad: You can pay via PayPal
examples.good: You can order with Fiverr checkout

rules.rewrite: order through Fiverr

rules.name: Bank transfer details
rules.rationale: Bank and wire details are payment-outside-Fiverr signals.
rules.suggestion: Remove; use Fiverr checkout.

examples.bad: Send a bank transfer to my IBAN
examples.good: Place the order and I start right away

rules.rewrite: order through Fiverr

rules.name: Crypto payment words
rules.rationale: Crypto terms suggest paying outside the platform. (False positive if your gig is about crypto work.)
rules.suggestion: Remove; use Fiverr checkout.

examples.bad: I take USDT too
examples.good: Fiverr checkout keeps both of us covered

rules.rewrite: order through Fiverr

rules.name: Pay outside / direct payment
rules.rationale: Asking for payment or tips outside Fiverr is a serious violation and a top reason for restrictions.
rules.suggestion: Take every payment, tip included, through Fiverr.

examples.bad: You can pay me directly and save fees
examples.good: Order through Fiverr and tip inside the platform

rules.rewrite: order through Fiverr

rules.name: 'pay me'
rules.rationale: Confirmed live: the word 'pay' in a seller message triggered the block.
rules.suggestion: Say 'my fee'.

examples.bad: Pay me after the draft
examples.good: My fee is on the package page

rules.rewrite: my fee

rules.name: 'pay / payment' (incl. pa.y)
rules.rationale: Confirmed live: 'pay' and 'payment' tripped the filter in an otherwise normal message.
rules.suggestion: Rephrase with 'fee' or 'order'. Never write 'pa.y' - that looks like evasion.

examples.bad: Please pay for the extra revision
examples.good: The extra revision has its own fee

rules.rewrite: fee

rules.name: Asking for a 5-star review
rules.rationale: Requesting a specific star rating is review manipulation.
rules.suggestion: Ask for honest feedback instead.

examples.bad: Please leave me a 5 star review
examples.good: I would value your honest feedback

rules.rewrite: share your honest feedback

rules.name: Incentivised review
rules.rationale: Trading discounts, refunds or bonuses for a positive review is prohibited.
rules.suggestion: Remove the incentive; you can only ask for honest feedback.

examples.bad: I will add a bonus for a 5 star review
examples.good: Reviews help other buyers decide

rules.name: Pressure against negative reviews
rules.rationale: Discouraging negative reviews is review manipulation.
rules.suggestion: Offer help fixing issues without conditions on the review.

examples.bad: Please don't leave a bad review
examples.good: Tell me what to improve and I will fix it

rules.name: Fake or paid reviews
rules.rationale: Buying, selling or fabricating reviews is banned.
rules.suggestion: Remove it.

examples.bad: I sell 5 star reviews cheaply
examples.good: I help you collect real testimonials

rules.name: Title over 80 characters
rules.rationale: Fiverr gig titles are capped at 80 characters; longer text is cut or rejected.
rules.suggestion: Cut filler words; lead with the service and keep the keyword near the start.

examples.bad: I will design a modern professional minimalist logo with brand guidelines and unlimited revisions fast
examples.good: I will design a modern minimalist logo with brand guidelines

rules.name: Keyword stuffing
rules.rationale: Repeating one keyword 3+ times in a title (or heavily in a description) reads as stuffing to buyers and moderators.
rules.suggestion: Use the keyword once, then add related terms.

examples.bad: I will design logo design, logo design for business logo design
examples.good: I will design a clean logo for your startup

rules.name: ALL CAPS ratio
rules.rationale: Shouting in capitals reads as spam and hurts conversion.
rules.suggestion: Use sentence case; keep capitals for acronyms.

examples.bad: I WILL DESIGN A STUNNING LOGO FOR YOUR BRAND
examples.good: I will design a stunning logo for your brand

rules.name: Emoji spam
rules.rationale: Strings of emoji look like spam and are a common reason for gig edits.
rules.suggestion: Use plain text in titles and at most a few emoji elsewhere.

examples.bad: I will design your logo 🔥🚀✨
examples.good: I will design your logo

rules.name: Missing 'I will' title convention
rules.rationale: Fiverr gig titles are conventionally written as 'I will ...' and search matches that phrasing.
rules.suggestion: Start with 'I will' followed by the service.

examples.bad: Professional logo design
examples.good: I will design a professional logo

rules.name: Thin description (<120 words)
rules.rationale: Very short descriptions rank and convert worse and give buyers little to trust.
rules.suggestion: Cover what is included, process, who it is for and what you need from the buyer.

examples.bad: I will make a logo for you.
examples.good: I design clean logos for small businesses and I include the source files and three revisions in every package. rules.name: Guarantee claims
rules.rationale: Guaranteed rankings, sales or results can't be promised and are flagged as misleading.
rules.suggestion: Describe the process and past deliverables, not guaranteed outcomes.

examples.bad: Guaranteed #1 ranking on Google in 7 days
examples.good: I deliver on time and offer free revisions until you are happy

rules.name: Banned superlatives
rules.rationale: Unprovable superlatives weaken trust and can be edited out by moderators.
rules.suggestion: Replace with a specific, checkable claim.

examples.bad: I am the #1 designer on Fiverr
examples.good: I design clean logos for startups

rules.name: Trademark impersonation
rules.rationale: Claiming to be an official partner of a brand you are not is impersonation and a policy violation.
rules.suggestion: Describe your real experience with the tool instead.

examples.bad: Official Google Partner agency
examples.good: I build Shopify stores that load fast

rules.name: Excess exclamation marks
rules.rationale: Stacked exclamation marks read as spam.
rules.suggestion: Use one at most.

examples.bad: Order now!!!
examples.good: Order now!

rules.name: Keyword dump list
rules.rationale: A long comma-separated list of keywords is stuffing and unreadable.
rules.suggestion: Turn it into sentences that describe what you deliver.

examples.bad: logo, branding, logo design, brand identity, minimalist logo, business logo, modern logo, custom logo, vector logo
examples.good: I design logos and brand identities for small businesses.

rules.name: Generic greeting (Dear Sir/Madam)
rules.rationale: Template greetings are the first sign of copy-paste offers, and buyers skip them.
rules.suggestion: Use the buyer's name or reference something specific from the request.

examples.bad: Dear Sir, I can help you
examples.good: Hi, I can help you

rules.rewrite: Hi,

rules.name: Generic expertise claim
rules.rationale: 'I am an expert in this field' says nothing specific and appears in most spam offers.
rules.suggestion: Name one relevant project or result you can verify.

examples.bad: I am an expert in this field
examples.good: I built three n8n workflows for lead capture last quarter

rules.name: 'I read your request'
rules.rationale: This opener is pasted into every offer and signals no real reading.
rules.suggestion: Prove you read it by quoting a detail or asking one specific question.

examples.bad: I have read your request carefully
examples.good: You mention a Shopify store with 300 SKUs; are the images already cropped?

rules.name: 'I can do this perfectly'
rules.rationale: Confident but contentless; buyers read it as spam.
rules.suggestion: State how you would do it in one line.

examples.bad: I can do this perfectly
examples.good: I would start with a wireframe and send it today

rules.name: Unfilled template placeholder
rules.rationale: Sending '[name]' or '{{client}}' proves the message is a template.
rules.suggestion: Fill in or delete every placeholder before sending.

examples.bad: Hi [name], I can help
examples.good: Hi Sara, I can help

rules.name: 'Check my portfolio'
rules.rationale: Pushing the buyer to do the work of evaluating you; lazy pitch.
rules.suggestion: Link one relevant sample in your gig gallery and say why it matches.

examples.bad: Please check my portfolio
examples.good: My gallery sample #2 is the closest match to your brief

rules.name: Request response under 25 words
rules.rationale: Very short offers rarely show that you understood the brief.
rules.suggestion: Restate the goal, give a plan in one line, and ask one question.

examples.bad: Hi I can do it
examples.good: You need a landing page for your dental clinic and I would start by sketching the booking flow then ask which services matter most before sending the first draft today.
